module.purpose: Provides the React hook and selector helpers for reading the current connection state from the React Flow store, optionally transforming that state through a caller-provided selector.
module.summary: This module bridges the internal React Flow store with React components through a connection-state hook. It converts an in-progress connection endpoint from screen coordinates into renderer coordinates, supports optional typed projections of connection data, and uses shallow comparison to avoid unnecessary component re-renders.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive graph editing by exposing live connection attempts to node and handle UI. Failure would prevent components from reflecting connection validity or active connection targets.
functions: storeSelector (~L7-12): Reads connection state and transforms active endpoint coordinates.
getSelector (~L14-23): Builds a typed store selector with optional projection.
useConnection (~L52-57): Exposes selected connection state through a React hook.

units.name: storeSelector

detail.name: storeSelector
preconditions: s is a ReactFlowStore containing a connection state and transform.
postconditions: Returns a new object containing the connection state properties.
If connection.inProgress is true, the returned to point is the result of pointToRendererPoint(connection.to, transform).
If connection.inProgress is false, the returned connection properties are unchanged.
invariants: The input store and its connection state are not mutated.
The returned object is a shallow copy of the connection state.
edgeCases: When connection.inProgress is true, the to point is transformed and all other connection properties are copied.
When connection.inProgress is false, the to point is not transformed and all connection properties are copied.
detail.summary: Returns a copied connection state from the React Flow store. When a connection is in progress, it converts the connection endpoint to renderer coordinates before returning it.

specTests.when: storeSelector is called with the store.
specTests.then: It returns a new connection-state object whose to property equals pointToRendererPoint(connection.to, transform), while preserving the other connection properties.

specTests.when: storeSelector is called with the store.
specTests.then: It returns a new shallow copy of the connection state without transforming the to property and without mutating the input store.

units.name: getSelector

detail.name: getSelector
detail.signature: getSelector(connectionSelector?: (connection: ConnectionState<InternalNode<NodeType>>) => SelectorReturn): (s: ReactFlowStore) => SelectorReturn | ConnectionState<InternalNode>
postconditions: Returns a selector function accepting a ReactFlowStore.
When connectionSelector is provided, the returned selector applies it to the connection state selected from the store.
When connectionSelector is not provided, the returned selector exposes the connection state selected from the store.
invariants: The connection state is obtained through storeSelector before any supplied connectionSelector is applied.
edgeCases: When connectionSelector is omitted, the returned selector yields the connection state from storeSelector without transformation.
When connectionSelector is provided, its result is returned for the connection state obtained from storeSelector.
detail.summary: Returns a React Flow store selector that either exposes connection state directly or transforms that state through the supplied selector.

specTests.when: The selector returned by getSelector(connectionSelector) is invoked with the store.
specTests.then: It obtains connection state through storeSelector and returns the value produced by connectionSelector for that state.

specTests.when: The selector returned by getSelector() is invoked with the store.
specTests.then: It returns the connection state selected by storeSelector.
